scenarios.title: Display corrected environment variable name in setup message
scenarios.purpose: Verify that when the API is not ready, the setup message shows the updated 'OPENAI_KEY' environment variable instead of 'OPENAI_API_KEY'.

steps.expected: Configure OPENAI_KEY and DATABASE_URL to enable reviews. See the setup guide.

scenarios.title: Setup message does not show old environment variable name
scenarios.purpose: Ensure that the old environment variable name 'OPENAI_API_KEY' is not present in the setup message when API is not ready.
